findings.issue_category: missing key policy / default full access
findings.description: No key_policy is defined for this KMS key, so AWS applies the default policy granting the entire account root user (and by extension any IAM principal granted kms:* permissions) full administrative and usage rights over the key. For a key protecting an audit trail bucket, this violates least privilege and should instead be scoped to only the specific roles/services that need to encrypt or decrypt audit data.

The resource does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so automatic annual key rotation is disabled by default. For a key protecting sensitive audit-trail data, failing to rotate the key increases the blast radius if the key material is ever compromised.
